title: Reconcile released main-only commits back into develop
description: origin/main contains released 0.27.0 work that is not in origin/develop, while develop also has substantial unique work. Build a clean main-to-develop synchronization PR from current remote refs, inventory conflicts by feature, preserve released behavior, run full CI, and never merge or cherry-pick the dirty legacy develop worktree.

comments.author: Codex
comments.text: Recovered by branch inventory: use a deliberate synchronization PR after active feature recovery, not the dirty local develop checkout.
